properties.name: A real test run is fed back in the unit a test runner reports — the file — without hand-mapping check ids
properties.statement: A design shall accept a real test run's outcomes per test file and resolve each file to the checks the design says it carries, so a run can be fed back as it comes out of the runner. Common runner outputs (cargo test text, JUnit XML, a script's exit code) shall convert to that form without hand-mapping. Files the design names no check for are reported, never silently dropped, and a file whose target never produced a result counts as failed.
